def keypos(fr):

            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
    return None
print("key now:", keypos(current_frame))
for mv in ['UP','RIGHT','DOWN','LEFT']:
    action([mv])
    print(mv, "key:", keypos(current_frame), "level:", current_frame.level)
    if current_frame.level!=2: break
